name: Dominick Reyes
summary: Former two-time title challenger (16-5, 10-5 UFC), a long southpaw with a sharp left hand and knockout power. Rebuilt with three straight stoppages (Jacoby, Smith, Krylov), was knocked out by Carlos Ulberg in R1, then edged Johnny Walker by split decision in a low-output fight. Dangerous early, but he has been stopped four times.

how_they_fight.Striking: Rangy southpaw (about 196 cm reach) who works off the jab and straight left and counters well; 9 of his 16 wins are R1 KOs, incl. Krylov at 2:24 and Jacoby at 2:00. Can also pour on volume when comfortable: 121 significant strikes in the R2 TKO of Anthony Smith.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Mostly defensive: strong takedown defense (about 80%) and rarely shoots. Can finish on top when he hurts people (ground strikes vs Smith).
how_they_fight.Defense: Durability is the question: KO'd by Jan Blachowicz (R2), Jiri Prochazka (R2), Ryan Spann (R1) and Ulberg (R1, 4:27), who pressed forward and smothered his punches. Walker chopped his lead leg with low kicks through R1 and R2 at UFC 327 (per LowKick).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast finisher: 11 of 12 finishes in round one, one in R2; 4 wins by decision (two of them split). Losses: 4 stoppages (R1 x2, R2 x2) plus the five-round decision to Jon Jones. If the fight passes R1 he tends to slow down and fight cautiously, as vs Walker, where he was out-landed 42 to 34 but won a split decision.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Has become risk-averse since his KO losses; told Cageside Press that getting 'two checks means more than entertaining.' Patient, but can be passive enough to put close fights in the judges' hands.

patterns: Straight left / counter left hand early; most finishes in R1
Becomes cautious and low-volume if no early finish
Hurt by forward pressure (Ulberg, Blachowicz, Prochazka)
concerns: Stopped 4 times (2 in R1, 2 in R2), including R1 by Ulberg in Sept 2025
Age 36 and lower output; out-landed by Walker
Lead-leg kicks have been an issue
keys_to_beat: Press forward and crowd him; don't give him range for the straight left

news.text: Beat Johnny Walker by split decision (29-28, 28-29, 29-28) at UFC 327 in a fight the crowd booed; Reyes called it 'a good technical fight.'

Cageside Press wrote that Reyes had made a heavyweight debut by beating Marcin Tybura. Our verified data has no such fight; Tybura's 2026-08-01 loss was to Aleksandar Rakic, so this looks like an outlet error. Reyes stays at light heavyweight for UFC 333.
